dedupe.payload_digest: SHA-256 of exact authenticated raw webhook bytes

semantics.DUPLICATE_SAME: return existing terminal request/decision; do not create a second authority plan
semantics.CONFLICT: same delivery identity with different authenticated body digest; fail closed

dedupe.secret_hygiene: normalized event and durable record contain digest/metadata only; no fetched file bytes

selected_github_app_architecture.future_source_token: fresh repository-scoped installation token requested with Contents:read only
selected_github_app_architecture.security_boundary: source reader has read-only Contents scope and no provider mutation capability
selected_github_app_architecture.standing_root_limitation: the standing App registration still has administration:write for the existing C1 effect path; the future source-reader token must be narrowed and must never be used for Administration or deploy-key mutation
why_selected: no second App private key or standing root is introduced
clear separation between source-reader token scope and existing effect path

required_future_configuration.active_webhook_url: required but not supplied or configured in R2
required_future_configuration.webhook_secret: required but not supplied or configured in R2

immutable_read_plan.observation_commit_binding: transition verifier rejects observations whose commit_sha values do not equal the authenticated before/after SHAs

secret_transition.rule: before status is 404 or before digest differs from expected_private_material_sha256, and after status is 200 with after digest equal to expected_private_material_sha256
secret_transition.preferred_demo: before=404 and after=200 with exact digest
secret_transition.implementation: winner/c2/push-transition.ts compares statuses and digests only

required_order: generate one fresh disposable SSH key pair
derive public half from private half
install that exact public half as one fresh read-only deploy key
independently read and verify the installed deploy key
derive and store the public-key fingerprint
hash the exact private bytes that will later be exposed
create and durably attest policy v2 with target ID, public fingerprint, and private-material digest
only then induce the designated push

policy_v2.live_boundary: live lookup requires LIVE_PROVENANCE; local fixtures require explicit allowLocalFixture mode
policy_v2.pre_event_requirement: policy must be durably created, enabled, and attested before the future trigger push; the push payload is not treated as carrying creation-time authority
policy_v2.timestamp_limitation: push payload facts do not supply a trusted event timestamp; C2-B must preserve the attested policy-before-trigger ordering and record the delivery/readback evidence

preconditions: live-proven policy or explicit local-test mode

secret_handling.webhook_body_persistence: raw body is not persisted by default; only raw_body_sha256 is retained
secret_handling.source_reader_body: hash file content in memory and return status/digest metadata only
secret_handling.buffer_disposal: dedicated digest helper overwrites its working buffer and the supplied Buffer where possible

commands: npx tsc --noEmit --types node --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --skipLibCheck <C2 files and tests>

claims_earned: The prior secret-scanning source remains a valid local architecture but is live-blocked on the current setup.
GitHub push is an officially supported repository/App event with Contents:read as the App minimum.
The exact repository, branch, and secret path are policy-bound and cannot be selected by the event.
Immutable before/after reads and digest comparison provide a deterministic exact secret transition rule.
Policy v2 has no default target and requires actual target, digest, and provenance inputs.
The exact C1 request boundary and secret-hygiene rules are implemented locally.
The architecture is ready for the separately gated C2-B0 configuration/delivery-ping phase.
claims_forbidden: a live push webhook was received
the App currently has Contents:read or Push subscription
a webhook URL or secret was configured
a fresh deploy key or live policy v2 was created
a private secret was exposed in GitHub
a live causal C1 request was created
C2-B or full C2 is complete
